name: Fügenerhof
beschreibung:
Located in the entrance of the Zillertal valley, Hotel Fuegenerhof features spacious rooms, a soothing spa area, and exquisite regional dining. It caters perfectly to both active adventurers and wellness seekers.

The Spieljoch cable car, the Erlebnistherme Zillertal thermal spa, and scenic alpine paths are only moments away.
kurzbeschreibung: Hotel Fuegenerhof in Fuegen welcomes travellers with hearty Zillertal hospitality, wellness, and comfort.
